verified: Each new image URL returned image bytes that parsed as an image. Artwork-specific page fields, exact list item titles, exact exhibition scene alt text, or the ColBase object API were used. Institution logos, generic hero images, posters and ambiguous shared attachments were excluded. No image binaries are hosted in this repository.

blockers.British Museum: Object pages reject direct requests with HTTP 403; rendered-reader responses lack object images. 161 records remain unresolved.
blockers.Harvard: The official image server returns MissingKey and requires signed delivery parameters or a cookie.
blockers.Busan: The site returns a security access restriction page to this connection.
blockers.Other: Some records link to exhibitions, PDFs or list pages rather than a unique illustrated object page. Other remote requests return 403, 503 or a timeout.
